title: mc_tasks::ManipulabilityEllipsoidTask
description: Tracks the manipulability ellipsoid of a frame, a symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrix, toward a target ellipsoid with the geometry-aware error \(\mathrm{Log}_M(\hat{M})\) on the manifold of SPD matrices (Jaquier et al., IJRR 2021). The ellipsoid is the velocity manipulability \(\tilde{J}\tilde{J}^T\) or the force manipulability \((\tilde{J}\tilde{J}^T)^{-1}\) of the frame Jacobian in world coordinates, restricted to the selected world axes and measure joints. For D axes, the task dimension is D(D+1)/2: matrices are vectorized with the Mandel notation, the diagonal first, then each superdiagonal times \(\sqrt{2}\).

joints.description:
Joints whose Jacobian columns define the ellipsoid
If empty, every joint between the robot root and the frame but a floating base
Use activeJoints to select the joints that change the ellipsoid

axes.description:
World axes of the ellipsoid, ordered as rotation then translation, a non-zero entry selects the axis
Defaults to the translation axes

ellipsoid.description:
Manipulability ellipsoid: the velocity ellipsoid, or the force ellipsoid (its inverse)
With useTorqueLimits, the force ellipsoid is in N² for the translation axes: lower the weight accordingly

error.description: Error between the ellipsoid and the target: the logarithmic map on the SPD manifold, or the Euclidean difference

target.description:
Target ellipsoid, a symmetric positive definite matrix given row by row, of the size of the number of axes
Defaults to the current ellipsoid

targetPosture.description:
Use the ellipsoid of the robot in this posture as the target (if target is not given)
Joints that are not given keep their current value

targetVel.description: Target ellipsoid velocity, a symmetric matrix given row by row (task reference velocity)

targetAccel.description: Target ellipsoid acceleration, a symmetric matrix given row by row (task reference acceleration)

useVelocityLimits.description: Use the robot velocity limits as the maximum joint velocities, the Jacobian columns are multiplied by these values (velocity ellipsoid only)

maxJointVelocity.description:
Maximum velocity of some measure joints (applied after useVelocityLimits, velocity ellipsoid only)
Defaults to 1

useTorqueLimits.description: Use the robot torque limits as the maximum joint torques, the Jacobian columns are divided by these values (force ellipsoid only)

maxJointTorque.description:
Maximum torque of some measure joints (applied after useTorqueLimits, force ellipsoid only)
Defaults to 1

displayScale.description:
Scale of the ellipsoids drawn in the GUI: their semi-axes are the square roots of the eigenvalues times this scale
Force ellipsoids with useTorqueLimits are in N, try 0.001
